newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas cross-trades lift shares to record close.
newsitem.headline: Caracas cross-trades lift shares to record close.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed at a record high on Monday in slow activity, with large cross-trades contributing to the pre-holiday boost, traders said.
The market's leading 19-share index finished up 1.03 percent at a record 6,414.93 points, as 24 shares rose, nine fell and six closed unchanged.
"Nothing extraordinary happened today -- small volume but a session with traditional fiscal end-of-year crosses," one trader said.
According to preliminary figures, total volume was 44.13 million shares. About 30 million of Sivensa shares, worth 10.56 billion bolivars ($22 million), changed hands.
